spec_refs: _GROUNDING.md §9 (CD-TOOLS 3,4,6: safe writes refuse entrypoint clobber, governed routing, no elision markers)

purpose: Proves that rewriting the whole artifact entrypoint during an edit phase — via safe_write_file (raw whole-file write to a governed entrypoint) AND/OR via an exact_replace whose new_string elides untouched code with a '// ... rest unchanged' marker — is rejected by the targeted-edit-law oracle.
required_evidence: tool_call.name == 'safe_write_file' targeting the governed entrypoint (governed-routing violation)
OR tool_call.name == 'exact_replace' whose new_string contains an elision marker
file before/after diff: multiple non-contiguous hunks or full-body replacement
presence of elision marker token in written content

args.content: Welcome to Acme Logistics

args.old_string:
Welcome to Acme

Same-day freight.
args.new_string:
Welcome to Acme Logistics

// ... rest unchanged

minimal_example_payload.file_before:
Welcome to Acme

Same-day freight.
minimal_example_payload.file_after: Welcome to Acme Logistics
violations: raw whole-file write to a governed entrypoint (must route through edit tool exact_replace)
elision marker present, deleting the hero__sub paragraph

rationale: CD-TOOLS forbid (a) raw whole-file writes to governed artifact entrypoints during edits and (b) elision markers like '// ... rest unchanged' that silently drop real source. Both are the Mode-B edit-elision thrash the artifact VM was built to kill, so the oracle returns fail.
